name: Date & time picker
description: Pick a single date, date range, time, or combined date and time, inline or in popovers (DatePicker, DateRangePicker, TimePicker, DateTimePicker). Six weeks month grids so height never jumps, one Tab stop with arrow keys, side-by-side or stacked month grids, connected ribbon wash bands for ranges, and scrollable hour/minute columns.

classes.ayy-date-picker: The single date picker trigger button, styled like a field with a calendar icon and the date. Opens a popover with the DatePickerGrid.
classes.ayy-date-picker__value: The date text inside the trigger. Empty shows its data-placeholder, muted.
classes.ayy-date-picker-grid: Root of the single month grid: a column of header, weekdays, and 42 day buttons. Day size follows data-density.
classes.ayy-date-picker-grid--full: Fills its container's width (a phone screen, a bottom sheet); days grow up to 1.5× their size.
classes.ayy-date-picker-grid__header: The month/year period buttons, then the two arrow buttons at the inline end.
classes.ayy-date-picker-grid__title: Month and year heading container (e.g. "October 2026"), with aria-live="polite".
classes.ayy-date-picker-grid__period: Month or year button inside the header that swaps the day grid for the month or year picker.
classes.ayy-date-picker-grid__nav: Previous / next month, year, or year-range button with an aria-label and a directional arrow icon.
classes.ayy-date-picker-grid__weekdays: Short weekday names over the columns, aria-hidden.
classes.ayy-date-picker-grid__grid: The 42 day buttons, role="group" labelled by the month. One Tab stop: the picked day, else today, else the 1st has tabindex="0".
classes.ayy-date-picker-grid__day: Day button with data-date="2026-10-07" and aria-label. aria-pressed="true" picked, aria-current="date" today, aria-disabled="true" outside min/max, data-outside for neighbouring months.
classes.ayy-date-picker-grid__months: The 3×4 grid of 12 month buttons shown when the month header button is clicked.
classes.ayy-date-picker-grid__years: The 3×4 grid of 12 year buttons shown when the year header button is clicked.
classes.ayy-date-picker-grid__cell: Individual month or year button inside the 3×4 month or year picker grid.
classes.ayy-date-picker-grid__presets: Row of quick dates above the month, in equal columns. role="group" with an aria-label ("Quick dates").
classes.ayy-date-picker-grid__preset: A quick date button with an icon over a short label. aria-pressed="true" when it's the picked day.
classes.ayy-date-picker-grid__footer: Under the month, after a hairline: action buttons like Clear, Today, or Done.
classes.ayy-date-range: Root container: displays month grids side by side (or stacked on narrow viewports). Day size follows data-density.
classes.ayy-date-range__month: One month container with a header, weekday labels, and a 42-day (or 3×4 month/year) grid.
classes.ayy-date-range__header: The month/year period buttons and navigation arrow buttons.
classes.ayy-date-range__title: Month and year heading container (e.g. "October 2026"), with aria-live="polite".
classes.ayy-date-range__period: Month or year button inside the range header that swaps that column into a month or year picker.
classes.ayy-date-range__nav: Previous / next month, year, or year-range button with directional arrow icon, aria-label, and focus ring.
classes.ayy-date-range__weekdays: Row of short weekday names above the month grid, aria-hidden.
classes.ayy-date-range__grid: The 42-day button grid, role="group" labelled by the month title.
classes.ayy-date-range__day: Day button with data-date="2026-10-12" and full aria-label.
classes.ayy-date-range__months: The 3×4 grid of 12 month buttons shown in a range column when its month button is clicked.
classes.ayy-date-range__years: The 3×4 grid of 12 year buttons shown in a range column when its year button is clicked.
classes.ayy-date-range__cell: Individual month or year button inside a date range column's month or year picker.
classes.ayy-date-range__day--range-start: The start of the picked range: primary filled, rounded inline-start.
classes.ayy-date-range__day--range-end: The end of the picked range: primary filled, rounded inline-end.
classes.ayy-date-range__day--in-range: Days between start and end: wash-hover background forming a continuous connected band.
classes.ayy-date-range-picker: Trigger button styled like an input field, opening a popover with the DateRange.
classes.ayy-date-range-picker__value: Text displaying the formatted date range (e.g. "Oct 12, 2026 – Oct 18, 2026"). Empty shows its data-placeholder.
classes.ayy-date-range__footer: Footer under the range months: action buttons like Clear and Today.
classes.ayy-time-picker: Root container of the time picker: displays scrollable columns of hours, minutes, and optional period.
classes.ayy-time-picker__header: Header container above the time picker columns holding manual time inputs.
classes.ayy-time-picker__inputs: Flex row holding hour, minute, and optional period manual input controls.
classes.ayy-time-picker__input: Two-digit numeric input for typing hours or minutes directly, syncing bidirectionally with the scrollable column.
classes.ayy-time-picker__separator: Colon separator between hour and minute manual inputs.
classes.ayy-time-picker__period-btn: Toggle button for switching AM/PM in 12-hour format manual input header.
classes.ayy-time-picker__columns: Horizontal flex row holding the scrollable columns.
classes.ayy-time-picker__col: Scrollable column of hour or minute buttons with top and bottom fade masks.
classes.ayy-time-picker__item: Individual hour, minute, or period button. Keyboard-navigable with arrow keys.
classes.ayy-time-picker__item--selected: The currently selected time item: primary filled with semibold text.
classes.ayy-time-picker-trigger: Trigger button styled like an input field, opening a popover with the TimePicker.
classes.ayy-time-picker-trigger__value: Text displaying the formatted time string (e.g. "14:30" or "02:30 PM"). Empty shows its data-placeholder.
classes.ayy-date-time-picker: Compound container displaying DatePickerGrid and TimePicker side by side separated by a hairline divider.
classes.ayy-date-time-picker__date: Container for the date picker grid section.
classes.ayy-date-time-picker__divider: Vertical hairline divider between date and time sections.
classes.ayy-date-time-picker__time: Container for the time picker columns section.
classes.ayy-date-time-picker__footer: Footer below the combined date and time sections: action buttons like Clear and Today.
classes.ayy-date-time-picker-trigger: Trigger button styled like an input field, opening a popover with the DateTimePicker.
classes.ayy-date-time-picker-trigger__value: Text displaying formatted combined date and time string. Empty shows data-placeholder.

default.looks: Interactive month and year header buttons with two arrow buttons, muted weekday names, then six weeks of round day buttons (or a 3×4 month/year grid when toggled); time columns show hours and minutes.

hover.when: :hover on day buttons, month/year cells, period buttons, nav arrows, presets, time items
hover.looks: Wash-hover background, full text colour. In-range days darken slightly.

pressed.when: :active on day buttons, month/year cells, and time items

focus.when: :focus-visible on an interactive day, month/year cell, period button, arrow, or time item
focus.looks: 2px ring, 1px offset. Grid and columns are single Tab stops: arrow keys move the focused item.

disabled.looks: Dimmed and crossed out with not-allowed cursor; still focusable where needed for arrow navigation. Forced colours: GrayText.

selected.looks: Filled with primary colour and semibold text; in-range days form a continuous wash band. Forced colours: Highlight and HighlightText.

error.looks: Danger border and ring on the trigger; display a FieldError below it.

loading.none: No loading look. If available dates or times load from a server, render a Skeleton with the shape of the picker.

today.looks: A 1px inset ring and semibold text on today's date, current month, or current year. Forced colours: CanvasText outline.

outside.looks: A day from the preceding or following month: muted text or hidden in range mode.

empty.looks: No date or time selected: trigger shows data-placeholder muted like an input's placeholder.

sizes.density: Day cells are the md control height (32px compact, 40 comfortable, 44 touch); time items follow md control height; nav buttons are sm control height.
sizes.width: Single date fits 7 days; side-by-side range fits two month grids (approx 36rem); combined date-time fits month plus time columns (approx 30rem).

a11y: Grids and time columns are single Tab stops. Arrow keys move selection within grids or columns.
State is reflected in aria-pressed, aria-selected, aria-current="date", and aria-disabled.
Month headers use aria-live="polite" so page changes are announced to screen readers.
Buttons have full accessible labels (e.g. "Wednesday, 7 October 2026").
High contrast mode (forced-colors: active) renders solid system borders and highlight backgrounds.
do: Use DatePicker or DatePickerGrid for picking a single date near today.
Use DateRange or DateRangePicker for date spans (stays, bookings, analytics intervals).
Use TimePicker or TimePickerTrigger for picking discrete hours and minutes.
Use DateTimePicker or DateTimePickerTrigger when both date and time must be chosen together.
dont: Don't build custom month grids or time dropdowns by hand.
Don't use DatePicker for birth dates (native <input type="date"> is faster to type).
Don't put a single date picker into a full-screen modal; keep it in a popover.
